calls.title: Doorlist + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around integrating Growth Book’s platform to streamline A/B testing, particularly focusing on non-engineering users. Key enhancements in the API and visual editor were highlighted, enabling programmatic management of experiments and facilitating user-friendly testing setups. A hybrid testing approach combining code-based and visual methods was advocated to improve flexibility and throughput while maintaining quality. Attendees also explored the platform’s capabilities for detailed experiment analysis and cohort breakdowns, and a skills library for AI agents was discussed to automate experiment management and reduce manual overhead. Current challenges included engineering bottlenecks and limitations from reliance on Posthog, with a commitment to ongoing collaboration for future improvements.
calls.keywords: AB testing, agentic workflows, GrowthBook API, Posthog, experimentation platform, feature flags
